 Chaos Zero Nightmare Recognized at Google Play's "Best of 2026" Awards, Winning "Best Story" in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau
 News provided by
 Smilegate
 Nov 18, 2026, 00:00 ET
 Share this article
 Share this article
 - The award highlights the game's deep world-building and immersive gameplay experience 
 SEOUL, South Korea , Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Smilegate announced on the 18th (Wed) that Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN), a dark fantasy roguelike RPG developed by Super Creative and published by Smilegate, has been named "Best Story" for the Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau region in Google Play's "Best of 2026."
 Google Play's "Best of" awards are held every year to recognize the apps and games most loved by users over the past year.
 Continue Reading
 Chaos Zero Nightmare Recognized at Google Play’s “Best of 2026” Awards, Winning “Best Story” in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau 
 CZN has drawn attention since launch with its dark fantasy setting, in which survivors fight to stay alive aboard a massive ship, an "Ark," in a world destroyed by an unexplained phenomenon known as "Chaos." In particular, its main story, which unfolds around a new theme each season, and the "Trauma Code," a feature that tells the secrets behind each Combatant's "trauma" in story form, have earned praise from players around the world. With this award, the game has also been recognized for the depth of its world and its immersive gameplay experience.
 Kim Joo Hyung, Head of Business at Smilegate, stated, "Over the past year since launch, we have worked hard to deliver an even more polished gameplay experience to our players, which makes this award all the more meaningful." He added, "The entire development team will continue to do our best to keep evolving for the better with every season."
 CZN is available for download on Google Play. For more information on the game, visit the official channels on " X " and " YouTube ," as well as STOVE's official website .
